sources.supports: OpenAI's GPT-4 model page lists the standard input price as $30 per million tokens.
OpenAI's GPT-4 model page lists the standard output price as $60 per million tokens.

notes: The provider's documented GPT-4 prices are $30 input and $60 output, so the earlier $10/$30 models.dev entry appears to have been a catalog error. I could not date the correction: the Internet Archive CDX request for pricing-page snapshots returned HTTP 503, and no provider source retrieved here states an effective date.
